approved: Creative Australia (Consequential and Transitional Provisions) Bill 2023
Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications and the Arts
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would repeal the old Australia Council Act and set up transitional rules for the new Creative Australia body.
It would confirm that the existing Australia Council continues as Creative Australia, keeping its chief executive, employees, consultants, assets and liabilities.
All current board members would lose their positions at the transition time, but could be reappointed under the new Act.
Confirms the Australia Council continues as Creative Australia with the same chief executive, employees and consultants.
Transfers assets and liabilities of the Australia Council to Creative Australia.
Ends all current board appointments and committee memberships at the transition time.
Allows the Minister to make rules by legislative instrument.
Provides compensation for any acquisitions of property.
The Australia Council, its board members, employees, consultants, and the Minister.
Creative Australia (Consequential and Transitional Provisions) Act 2023
